meta.title: Night Ferry
meta.key: D, suspended: Dsus2, Bbmaj7#11, Fsus2, Cadd9
meta.words: v2: the tubular bells are now native (a tube's beating partials); otherwise as v1. Dub, with suspended chords that never settle (Dsus2, B flat Lydian, Fsus2, Cadd9, four bars each). Lazy lo-fi drums, dub chord swells into a long echo, tubular bells far off, a dub sub, the sweeping pad.
